title: clustered-page-rewrite-and-eviction-smoothing-with-budgeted-background-compaction
author: Ariella Stone
description: Motivation: Tenant KV memory pressure spikes and micro-fragmentation were causing noisy eviction storms and unpredictable tail latency. This PR introduces a clustered page-rewrite path plus an eviction-smoothing controller and a budgeted background compaction worker to reduce fragmentation and smooth spillover. Approach: 1) Add a clustered page-rewrite that groups small hot pages by tenant and rewrites them into contiguous slots to improve locality and reduce free-fragmentation; 2) Implement eviction-smoothing: instead of issuing large synchronous evictions under pressure, the controller issues paced eviction batches with tenant-aware watermarks and backpressure tokens to downstream spillers; 3) Introduce a budgeted-background-compaction worker that runs low-priority compaction (rewrite+free coalescing) during idle CPU/GPU windows and honors a configurable per-tenant IO/cpu budget; 4) Integrate hooks in the scheduler to prefer rewritten contiguous pages for kernel dispatch and KV cache lookups; 5) Expose runtime flags and per-tenant knobs for rollout. Benchmark summary: mixed generation workload (seq=512, batch=16) observed median token latency improvement ~7% and P95 improvement ~12% for high-fragmentation synthetic traces; background IO overhead capped at configured 5% by default. Migration & rollout: feature gated by "kv.clustered_rewrite" and "kv.evict_smoothing" flags; rollout plan uses canary on dedicated pools then gradual ramp. Risks & mitigations: background compaction may increase IO during peak—mitigated by budget throttle and tenant elevation; rollback via feature flag. Related: ENG-1248, ENG-1302. Checklist: [x] design doc updated; [x] unit and integration tests added; [x] perf bench harness updated; [x] feature flags added; [x] docs note added.

review_conversation: Devon Park (reviewer): Initial design looks promising. Concern: clustered rewrite could increase transient memory usage when coalescing pages. Suggest a soft-limit and early abort path if memory headroom is low.
Ariella Stone (author): Good point. Added memory headroom check and abort path; compactor honors per-tenant budget to avoid transient spikes.

Kenji Sato (reviewer): Observed a lint failure on first CI run for clustered_rewrite.cc - style nit and missing documentation header. Also add metrics: compactor_cycles_total and eviction_smooth_batches for SLO validation.
Ariella Stone (author): Addressed lint, added header comments, and exported metrics. Re-ran CI; lint and unit tests now pass.
Marta Ruiz (reviewer): Can we add an emergency bypass that disables background compaction if disk IO latency crosses threshold? We do not want compaction to make tail worse during noisy neighbors.
Ariella Stone (author): Added IO latency probe and emergency bypass flag kv.compaction_disable_on_io_spike. Default is enabled; documented in tuning guide.
Devon Park (approver): Verified perf numbers on canary pool; P50 -7%, P95 -12% on fragmentation traces. Approving to merge.
